violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

There was no evidence that employees are required to report to the person in charge information about their health (illnesses, symptoms) as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food. State example provided during time of inspection; staff to review and PIC to retain. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Guidance document provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
Handwashing aids were observed at food prep sink. PIC informed to remove dispensers. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Staff stated dishes are only washed and rinsed with soap and water. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Sanitizer was set up at 3 bay sink during time of inspection and guidance document provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Cooked Adobo sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Food was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for pupusas and cooked adobo sauce. Pupusas were observed at 66 degrees Fahrenheit with lid. Cooked adobo sauce was observed in 22 qt plastic cambro at 51 degrees Fahrenheit. Proper cooling methods reviewed and guidance document provided during time of inspection. Lid on pupusas was removed to continue cooling process. Cooked adobo sauce was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the the rear near basement and storage area, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Wood is used in the construction of shelving fixtures. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
3 bay sink was observed leaking from discharge pipe. System to be in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
Various ceiling tiles, and ceiling panel caps were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026
The floors in the kitchen area are in poor repair. Poor condition is affecting cleanability. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the warewashing, prep and cook room. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Raw chicken was observed stored above cooked beans and meat in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/05/2025

The following were observed in poor repair: 1. gaskets at the prep unit near flattop 2. gaskets at the hot holding unit Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2025

The Person in charge was not knowledgeable of sanitizing food contact surfaces. The person in charge must demonstrate to the health department knowledge of foodborne disease prevention, application of HACCP principles, and the requirements of this Code. 3 bay sink was set up during time of inspection. Retail Food Safety booklet provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025

The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Retail Food Safety booklet provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025

Raw chicken was observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as raw onions in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025

Food contact surfaces of the can opener were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025

Steak and Salsa were observed held at 118 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per interview of staff, foods were recently cooked. Foods were reheated during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025
Salsa verde was observed held past 7 days. Food was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2025

The doors to the outside, located in the back, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025
Employee beverage was observed in ice in ice machine. Establishment informed to cease practice. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025

The following were observed in poor repair: 1. gaskets at the prep unit near flattop 2. gaskets at the hot holding unit 3. air drying racks above 3 bay sink Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025

The floors in the kitchen were observed in poor repair. Floors observed with pitting affecting cleanability. Physical facilities to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025

Employees' clothing or other personal belongings were observed stored with dry ingredients. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2025
